evidence: Has the Tests label and adds stream formatting utilities to src/test/util/common.{h,cpp} applied across unit tests.
rationale: Improves unit test failure diagnostics across multiple subsystems and prepares display formatting for future test runner migration (#35713). It adds `operator<<` overloads for types like `FeeFrac`, `CScript`, and `CAddress` and converts `BOOST_CHECK` to `BOOST_CHECK_EQUAL`, which provides clear developer quality-of-life value on test failure but is reasonably deferrable.
